classification_policy.universal_software_foundation: Reuse a suitable dependency when available; do not claim uniqueness for collections, arithmetic, hexadecimal alphabet, windows or JSON.
classification_policy.user_permission: No user-required request/response, time window, expiry or evidence functionality removed.
